B1.statement: at equal row budget, DIVERSITY beats DEPTH

B2.statement: the DIVERSITY advantage is larger on hard chemistry than overall
B2.pass_condition: gain at hard_vs_BASEtrain_nn<0.4 > gain overall, both CI95 low > 0

B3.statement: the DEPTH curve slope between the two largest budgets is within noise of zero

curve_shape.note: one row per (split seed, policy, budget, draw), folds aggregated

budgets_met_exactly.note: a shortfall is only legitimate when the fold's whole training pool is smaller than the budget; then the selection must equal the pool

all_budget_points_identical.note: at budget 'all' every policy and draw trains on the fold's whole pool, so their metrics must coincide exactly
